name: Report to Captain Stoutfist
label: Quest
description: Report to Captain Stoutfist is an Alliance military directive in Menethil Harbor. Following initial skirmishes against the Dragonmaw clan at Dun Algaz…
intro: Report to Captain Stoutfist is an Alliance military directive in Menethil Harbor. Following initial skirmishes against the Dragonmaw clan at Dun Algaz, Valstag Ironjaw sends proven combatants inside the harbor's keep to coordinate deeper defense efforts. Captain Stoutfist commands the local garrison and is organizing direct strikes against the entrenched orcs across the Wetlands.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend. The Dragonmaw orc clan is showing its strength in more than just Algaz. Captain Stoutfist has asked to speak with those willing to offer aid against these orcs. He is inside the keep, in the war room.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Friend. Valstag briefed me on your past success with the Dragonmaw Orcs at Dun Algaz. You're a traveler of worth.
And I have a task for you.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
